sentences.en: "That makes it as clear as crystal," said the inspector.
sentences.zh: ‘这使得情况一清二楚。’探长说道。

sentences.en: Sami was talking about some sort of a healing crystal.
sentences.zh: 萨米在谈论某种治疗用的水晶。

sentences.en: I found a beautiful crystal on the beach last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我在海滩上发现了一块美丽的水晶。

senses.zh: 结晶，晶体；水晶；水晶玻璃；（钟表的）石英玻璃保护面，表蒙子
